foil.title: GPS interference in Eastern Mediterranean shipping zone
foil.scenario_short: 49 jamming hexes in Eastern Mediterranean. For now, the base case stays near 53% over the 7d. Actors absorb the current evidence mix without a decisive break toward either shock or relief.
foil.perspective_strategic: 49 jamming hexes in Eastern Mediterranean is setting the strategic baseline, and the current 50% probability implies a live but not settled risk path.
foil.perspective_contrarian: Confidence is only 42%, implying thin source diversity or mixed calibration. If that restraint persists, the forecast can move below the current 50% baseline. Actors prioritize containment and the system drifts toward stabilization unless new hard signals emerge.
foil.actor_lens: Shipping operators: Keep critical flows through Eastern Mediterranean functioning over the 7d. Adjust routing and contingency plans around Eastern Mediterranean.

seismic-infrastructure.absence_reason: No product publishes a seismic forecast — earthquakes are not predictable, so there is no forecast/intel alternative to azimuth's observed USGS record. This is the honest inverse: for an observed natural-hazard fact, the sourced record IS the only trustworthy source.
